first_missing_criterion: Current record-level official/public physical building-footprint Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry for an Exeter building, bound to explicit building name/type/use evidence. Devon County Council's official live Listed buildings layer 669 publishes polygon geometry and uses Name as its display field, but its own service description states that records in central Exeter are out of date. Because stale central-Exeter geometry cannot satisfy the current physical-footprint criterion, this source-area metadata window receives no parcel-progress credit and no individual building record was accepted.
